page.verifyTitle: Not in the index — it'll say so honestly.
page.verifyLead2: If nothing is found — returns completeness: "minimal" and an explicit message. If found but uncertain — LOW_CONFIDENCE warning with a percentage. Low confidence results are not cached.
page.agentLead2: Three modes: instant — fast, auto — balanced, thinking — reasoning chain before the answer.
page.agentLead1: --agent returns structured JSON with schemaVersion: "agent-response-v1". Agents get exact citations with file position — no guessing context.
page.heroDescription: Semantic code search. Returns citations with file position and confidence scores. We use it ourselves — to navigate KB Labs and give AI agents context without hallucinations.
page.verifyLead1: Every answer is tied to real chunks from the index with exact file and line numbers. The system cannot cite a source that isn't in the codebase.
